name: XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM
description:
ClaimChart LLM by XLSCOUT connects Claude to XLScout’s AI-assisted patent infringement analysis workflow.
First, users authenticate with their XLScout account. They can then enter a patent number, review and select a claim, and receive a ranked list of candidate products and companies for infringement review. Users can choose target products or companies, optionally enable recurring monitoring alerts, and submit the case to generate a detailed element-by-element claim chart report.
The connector is designed for IP researchers, patent monetization teams, university technology transfer offices, law firms, licensing professionals, and corporate IP teams evaluating evidence of use, licensing opportunities, competitive technology landscapes, and portfolio monetization strategies.
Key features include:
•	XLScout account authentication before accessing workflows
•	Patent-number-based claim analysis
•	Claim review and claim selection
•	AI-assisted identification of candidate products and companies
•	Target selection for claim chart generation
•	Optional recurring monitoring alerts
•	Detailed element-by-element claim chart report generation
•	Support for evidence-of-use, licensing, and patent monetization workflows
ClaimChart LLM outputs are intended to support research, review, and evidence-of-use workflows. They do not constitute legal advice or a final legal determination of infringement.

_published_faq.name: How do I add XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://patdigger.mcp.xlscout.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM provides these MCP tools: analyze_patent_for_infringement, fetch_patent_claims, generate_key_features_from_claims, login_to_xlscout, search_companies_from_patent_ucids, and submit_patent_infringement_ranking.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
XLSCOUT ClaimChart LLM is developed by XLSCOUT XLPAT INC. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
